source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: saveAndCloseItemDialog registers its calendar observer before clicking Save and Close, then awaits both window closure and the itemSaved promise. onAddItem or onModifyItem resolves that promise. The manager holds the observer in its calendar-wide collection; the helper callback does not filter an item or calendar. This distinguishes a save notification from window closure or the later event-box wait without claiming a specific rendered item or a reproduced intermittent repair.
title: The Calendar save helper waits for an item notification after window closure
